# authwise_theme_variant (Data Source)

A theme variant: a theme, changed for one issuer. It names its base theme (`theme_id`) and holds only what differs, key by key, in `stylesheet_attributes` and `content`. What applies, in order: the application's variant (`theme_variant_id`), then the audience's, then the issuer's default variant (`is_default`), then the tenant's default theme.

Formerly `authwise_appearance_profile` (kit#968): a `moved` block from `authwise_appearance_profile` carries the state across. This data source reads one by its full resource name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Full resource name of the object to read.

### Read-Only

- `content` (String)
- `display_name` (String)
- `is_default` (Boolean)
- `issuer_id` (String)
- `labels` (Map of String)
- `stylesheet_attributes` (String)
- `tenant_id` (String)
- `theme_id` (String)
- `theme_variant_id` (String) Server-assigned resource id — the last segment of `name`, and what other resources' `*_id` attributes take.
